shipLog.text: ◆ At every stop, press STOP for the full menu of services! Every action has a time cost and an effort cost! RESUME when you're done! Enjoy!
◆ Crop planted! CHIP's agriculture partner GrowCo™ congratulates you on your planting decision! GrowCo™ did not make the seeds! They are sponsoring the concept!
NOW ARRIVING: Marginal Eden! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Departure Protocol: “Check the crop one last time before departure”! BOLD leadership!
The crop is fine. RESULTS: +2 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
◆ You have materials! Why buy when you can print? The FABRICATOR is in the Stop menu! Prints take a few days! Wear is normal! Probably!
NOW ARRIVING: Port Authority (Disputed)! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
Also: −1 O2.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Quarantine Flag: “"Stay as long as you like."”! BOLD leadership!
The officer stays twenty minutes and doesn't say much. RESULTS: +3 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Market Row: “BACK TO DOCK”! BOLD leadership!
RESULTS: 1 DAY! ★★★★★
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Station Inbound: “LEAVE STATION”! BOLD leadership!
RESULTS: nothing aboard changed! ★★★★★
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Welcome to the station! Every service is open: MARKET, MEDBAY, DRYDOCK, FAB SERVICE! Gold accepted! CHIP's favourite place in the universe!
NOW ARRIVING: FSS Due Diligence! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at It Tastes Like Pennies: “Boil it clean, a pot at a time”! BOLD leadership!
You boil the tank. RESULTS: −6 FUEL, −6 H2O, 4 DAYS. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ Your cargo hold is a treasure chest! INV opens it! SELL at stations for gold! JETTISON if you must! CHIP prefers SELL!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit VEGETATIVE! 30% grown, health 97. INVEST!
NOW ARRIVING: The One The Probe Liked! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Something New: “Let it grow”! BOLD leadership!
You leave the silver plant alone. RESULTS: +1 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
◆ Customise your voyage! Click the readout strip for ORDERS! Pace! Rations! Water split! All included!
NOW ARRIVING: Asteroid Field 5! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Grease Fire, Deck Two: “Reyes smothers it”! BOLD leadership!
The chef walks into the smoke with a lid in one hand and a… RESULTS: −8 FOOD, −3 MORALE, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ The crop card is your window into the growbay! Health! Water! Pests! Harvest! Everything a growing business needs!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit FLOWERING! 51% grown, health 100. INVEST!
NOW ARRIVING: Anomaly 6! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Reclaimer Coughs: “Print a replacement seal”! BOLD leadership!
The fabricator turns out a seal in the wrong color and… RESULTS: +15% FAB WEAR, −4 H2O, 2 DAYS. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ A fork! Two routes! Two experiences! The labels tell you what you're buying! CHIP respects honest labelling!
NOW ARRIVING: Route Decision! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 9 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Toll Lane: “Pay the toll: port lane”! BOLD leadership!
You pay. RESULTS: −8 GOLD, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ The MAP is free to use! It shows every stop and every fork! ??? means a mystery! SCAN removes the mystery! For a day!
